relationships.description: The gpt-4-turbo model is used to perform the 'glean' self-reflection technique.
The entity extraction process using gpt-4-turbo is evaluated on the HotPotQA dataset.
The HotPotQA dataset is associated with the paper by Yang et al., 2018.
The Leiden algorithm is associated with the paper by Traag et al., 2019.
The MultiHop-RAG dataset is associated with the paper by Tang and Yang, 2024.
OpenORD is associated with the paper by Martin et al., 2011.
Force Atlas 2 is associated with the paper by Jacomy et al., 2014.
